name: 11232 · Brooklyn, NY
findings: ZIP 11232 (Brooklyn) has 115 nonprofit organizations. 47 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 41 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11232 (Brooklyn) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 11232 (Brooklyn) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.3 times the typical level).
